verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say code review supports the Pull Request workflow and the AGit workflow, and that submitters can receive review comments and revise code. That covers proposing and merging changes. However, nothing in the pack documents forking a repository, or how outside contributors without write access submit cross-repo pull requests. Missing for 10: documented repository forking, cross-fork pull request flow for outside contributors, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can let outside contributors fork my repository and propose changes back via pull requests

citations.quote: Code review supports both the Pull Request workflow and AGit workflow.
Submitters can receive review comments and respond or modify code online.
